<!DOCTYPE html><script type="module">
window.addEventListener('message',async event=>{if(event.data.event!=='benchmark-start')return;try {
 const {root,module}=event.data;const load=p=>import('file://'+root+'/out/'+p);
 const [{IPCClient},{VSBuffer},{Emitter}]=await Promise.all([load(module),load('vs/base/common/buffer.js'),load('vs/base/common/event.js')]);
 const port=event.ports[0];const emitter=new Emitter();const protocol={send:message=>port.postMessage(message.buffer),onMessage:emitter.event};const client=new IPCClient(protocol,'renderer');port.onmessage=e=>emitter.fire(VSBuffer.wrap(e.data));port.start();const channel=client.getChannel('echo');const results=[];
 const settings=Object.fromEntries(Array.from({length:100},(_,i)=>['editor.setting'+i,{enabled:true,value:i,scopes:['user','workspace']} ]));
 for(const [name,arg] of [['primitive',42],['small-object',{command:'open',ids:[1,2,3]}],['settings-100',settings],['keys-1000',Array.from({length:1000},(_,i)=>'editor.setting'+i)]]) {
 const check=result=>{if(JSON.stringify(result)!==JSON.stringify(arg))throw new Error('mismatch '+name);};check(await channel.call('echo',arg));for(let i=0;i<200;i++)await channel.call('echo',arg);const times=[];for(let s=0;s<3;s++){const start=performance.now();let result;for(let i=0;i<1000;i++)result=await channel.call('echo',arg);times.push(performance.now()-start);check(result);}results.push({name,microsecondsPerRoundTrip:times});
 }
 window.reportBenchmark({module,bufferPoolSize:8192,results});client.dispose();port.close();
}catch(error){window.reportBenchmark({error:String(error.stack)});}});
</script>
